name: Asymmetric Encryption
description: Encrypt with an SM2 or RSA public key and decrypt with the matching private key.

hints.algorithm: SM2 output uses the C1C3C2 order with an 04 prefix; decryption auto-detects DER, C1C3C2 and C1C2C3 input.
hints.length: RSA ciphertexts are size-limited and long plaintexts are rejected; use symmetric encryption for large data.

faq.q: Can a Java library decrypt the SM2 ciphertext?
faq.a: Most implementations use C1C3C2, which matches the default here.

faq.q: What does "plaintext too long" mean for RSA?
faq.a: RSA can only encrypt a very small amount of data; use symmetric encryption instead.
